moments.title: Community Shield Showdown
moments.blurb: The traditional curtain-raiser for the English football season, the Community Shield, sees Premier League champions Arsenal take on FA Cup winners Manchester City this Sunday.

angles.name: Match Build-up
angles.copy: Arsenal vs Man City for the Community Shield this Sunday! Who's taking home the first silverware of the season? #CommunityShield

angles.name: London vs Manchester Rivalry
angles.copy: The capital takes on Manchester this weekend as Arsenal face City in the Community Shield. London, can the Gunners bring it home?

moments.title: Championship Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 EFL Championship season begins this weekend, with a full slate of fixtures including Bolton vs Preston and Stoke vs Swansea on Saturday.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Excitement
angles.copy: The Championship is BACK! Who are you backing for promotion this season as the new campaign kicks off this Saturday?

angles.name: Swansea's Start
angles.copy: Swansea City kick off their Championship season away to Stoke this Saturday. Big season ahead for the Swans – predictions?

moments.title: Cymru Premier Live on BBC iPlayer
moments.blurb: BBC Cymru Wales has secured a three-year deal for live coverage of the Novira Cymru Premier, with the first streamed match, Barry Town United vs Cardiff Met, airing this Saturday.

angles.name: Historic Welsh Football TV Deal
angles.copy: Huge news for Welsh football! The Cymru Premier is coming to BBC iPlayer for the next three years, starting with Barry Town Utd v Cardiff Met this Saturday.

angles.name: Local Teams on the Big Screen
angles.copy: Get ready to cheer on our local teams! The Cymru Premier gets live BBC iPlayer coverage starting this weekend. Who are you watching?

moments.title: Premier Sports Cup Last 16
moments.blurb: The Premier Sports Cup last-16 fixtures are taking place this weekend, with highlights including Kilmarnock vs Ayr United on Friday and Rangers vs St Mirren on Sunday.

angles.name: Scottish Cup Action
angles.copy: It's Premier Sports Cup last-16 weekend! Who's going through to the quarter-finals? Kilmarnock v Ayr Utd kicks us off on Friday.

angles.name: Rangers vs St Mirren
angles.copy: Big Sunday clash in the Premier Sports Cup as Rangers host St Mirren. Can the current holders defend their title?

moments.title: Boomtown Fair Underway
moments.blurb: The immersive music and arts festival, Boomtown Fair, kicks off today in Hampshire, running until Sunday, August 16, with its unique storyline and diverse line-up.

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: Boomtown Fair is officially open! Who's ready for four days of incredible music, art, and immersive storytelling in Hampshire? #Boomtown

angles.name: Immersive Experience
angles.copy: From hidden streets to epic stages, Boomtown is more than just a festival – it's an entire world. What's your favourite part of the Boomtown experience?

moments.title: Beautiful Days Festival
moments.blurb: The independent Beautiful Days festival returns to Escot Park in Ottery St Mary, Devon, this Friday, running until Sunday, August 16.

angles.name: Devon's Big Weekend
angles.copy: Beautiful Days Festival kicks off in Ottery St Mary this Friday! Who's heading to Escot Park for a weekend of live music and good vibes?

angles.name: Independent Festival Fun
angles.copy: Another year, another incredible line-up at Beautiful Days! Supporting independent festivals and enjoying the best of Devon this weekend.

moments.title: Country Calling UK Festival
moments.blurb: The inaugural Country Calling UK festival takes place this weekend (August 14-16) at Hylands Park in Chelmsford, bringing a host of country music stars to the UK.

angles.name: Calling All Country Fans
angles.copy: Y'all ready? Country Calling UK makes its debut this weekend in Chelmsford! Who's excited for a massive dose of country music?

angles.name: New Festival Buzz
angles.copy: A brand new festival hits the UK this weekend! Country Calling UK is bringing the Nashville sound to Chelmsford. What artists are you hoping to see?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's Chart Reign
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' made history on the Official UK Singles Chart (August 7, 2026) by spending its 20th consecutive week at Number 1, setting a new record.

angles.name: Chart Record Breakers
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still at Number 1 with 'Rein Me In' – 20 weeks and counting! Have you joined the record-breaking listenership?

angles.name: Unstoppable Hit
angles.copy: Twenty weeks at Number 1! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean just can't be stopped. What's your favourite lyric from the track?

moments.title: Ariana Grande's 'Petal' Blooms at Number 1
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande's eighth album, 'Petal', debuted at Number 1 on the Official UK Album Chart (August 7, 2026), with singles 'Petal' and 'Kiss Me' also entering the Top 40.

angles.name: Album Chart Queen
angles.copy: Ariana Grande is back at Number 1 with her new album 'Petal'! What's your favourite track from her latest masterpiece?

angles.name: New Music Friday Impact
angles.copy: Fresh from New Music Friday, Ariana Grande's 'Petal' has soared to the top of the album chart. Which of her new singles is on repeat for you?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Ben Gibbard
moments.blurb: Ben Gibbard, frontman of Death Cab For Cutie and The Postal Service, turns 49 today.

angles.name: Indie Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 49th Birthday to indie legend Ben Gibbard! What's your go-to Death Cab For Cutie or The Postal Service track?

angles.name: Celebrating a Songwriter
angles.copy: From 'Transatlanticism' to 'Such Great Heights,' Ben Gibbard's songwriting has shaped a generation. Wishing him a very happy birthday today!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Joe Jackson
moments.blurb: English singer-songwriter and musician Joe Jackson, known for hits like 'Is She Really Going Out with Him?' and 'Steppin' Out', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: New Wave Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to the brilliant Joe Jackson! What's your favourite track from the man who gave us 'Is She Really Going Out with Him?'

angles.name: Classic Hits Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating the timeless talent of Joe Jackson on his 71st birthday! Spin 'Steppin' Out' loud today.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Feargal Sharkey
moments.blurb: Feargal Sharkey, lead singer of The Undertones and solo artist known for 'A Good Heart', turns 68 on Thursday, August 13.

angles.name: Punk Rock Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to Feargal Sharkey! From The Undertones to his solo hits, his voice is unforgettable. What's your favourite?

angles.name: A Good Heart Remembered
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy Birthday to Feargal Sharkey this Thursday! 'A Good Heart' remains an absolute 80s classic.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Belinda Carlisle
moments.blurb: Belinda Carlisle, lead singer of The Go-Go's and iconic solo artist, will celebrate her 68th birthday on Sunday, August 17.

angles.name: 80s Pop Princess Birthday
angles.copy: Heaven is a place on Earth for Belinda Carlisle this Sunday as she turns 68! What's your favourite Go-Go's or solo hit?

angles.name: Celebrating a Pop Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a fantastic 68th birthday to the one and only Belinda Carlisle this weekend! Get ready to 'Runaway' with her greatest hits.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Phoebe Bridgers
moments.blurb: Critically acclaimed singer-songwriter Phoebe Bridgers, known for her indie-folk sound, turns 32 on Sunday, August 17.

angles.name: Modern Indie Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 32nd Birthday to the incredible Phoebe Bridgers this Sunday! What's your favourite track from her stunning discography?

angles.name: Songwriter Spotlight
angles.copy: Celebrating the unique artistry of Phoebe Bridgers on her 32nd birthday this weekend. Her lyrics always hit different.

moments.title: Peak Summer Holiday Season
moments.blurb: August is in full swing as the UK enters the peak summer holiday travel season, with many families enjoying breaks across the country and abroad.

angles.name: Holiday Rush
angles.copy: It's peak summer holiday season! Are you jetting off abroad, or enjoying a staycation closer to home this August? #SummerHolidays

angles.name: School's Out
angles.copy: Schools are out and the holidays are in full swing! What's been your favourite summer adventure so far?

moments.title: Free Bus Travel for Kids in England
moments.blurb: Under 16s in England can travel free on most local buses throughout August, part of a government scheme to help families with the cost of living during the summer holidays.

angles.name: Budget-Friendly Summer
angles.copy: Great news for families! Kids under 16 can travel free on buses across England all August. Perfect for those summer day trips! #FreeBusTravel

angles.name: Exploring England for Less
angles.copy: Fancy exploring somewhere new this summer? With free bus travel for kids in England, now's the time to visit those hidden gems!
